ideas.title: Following the Money in Health Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in health care fraud cases, including the sources of funding and the recipients of the fraudulent claims.
questions: What are the most common types of health care fraud?
How do perpetrators launder their funds?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of the scope and complexity of health care fraud, and identify potential targets for further investigation.
